name: HD Hyundai Heavy Industries Co., Ltd.
summary: HD Hyundai Heavy Industries Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the shipbuilding business in South Korea, North America, Asia, Europe, and internationally. It operates through four segments: Shipbuilding, Offshore Plants, Engine Machinery, and Others.
